justification: Follow-up to #1346 (merged one commit early). Campbelltown Part 4 still lost two council sentences the sentence check passed: page 13's continuation of 5.4.8.2 b (glued to copied items ii/iii) and the 4.1C note (a late stray match excused the rest). The check now splits at item labels and excuses only a heading-sized start (HEADING_RUN_MAX=12). Review of #1346: an unmeasured DQ-145 after a page repair write now exits 3.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a missing sentence scores as copied, a sentence with no copied run scores as copied, every re-read provision is kept, every figure-citing rule is dropped, or a DQ-145 rise is not reported
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Each of those five mutations failed a test; restored, all pass.

real_layer_exempt.scripts/ai_extractor.py: offline measure on saved review reads of 5 chapters (no AI call): flags 14G p5/p11, 14I p13, CB Part 4 p20 and 14D 'planned future character' paragraphs; 0 on 14J. Live review reads of the 3 held chapters run next.
real_layer_exempt.scripts/dcp_page_repair.py: unproven_count measured live: 107, the same as dq_probe_live --id DQ-145

pre_impl.existing_data: held chapters' review rows lack the intro/scope sentences printed on the PDF pages
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: page coverage judges a page by most of its rule lines, so an intro paragraph can be lost on a passed page
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: extends the reader after _reread_skipped_pages; reuses page_coverage.running_lines and doubled_text

functions.name: missing_sentences
functions.input: page number to page text, and the texts the reader returned
functions.output: page number to printed sentences the output does not hold
functions.if_none: empty dict, and no re-read happens

functions.name: report_unproven
functions.input: DQ-145 before and after the write, and the council
functions.output: printed comparison; exit 3 when it rose

values.read_at: share of a sentence's four-word runs that must be in the output, from its first copied run
values.if_missing: n/a (constant; 0.5 missed the Campbelltown scope sentences, measured)

values.read_at: most unmatched four-word runs excused at a sentence's start

queries.purpose: count served rules with unproven citations before and after the page repair write
queries.where_clause: the DQ-145 probe's own WHERE (is_current AND v2_is_actionable ...)

break_it.scenario: a heading with no full stop runs into the first sentence of a page
break_it.what_happens: the heading words are not counted against it
break_it.how: judged from the first copied four-word run

break_it.scenario: the re-read returns the whole page again
break_it.what_happens: only provisions holding a named missing sentence are added

break_it.scenario: a map legend or caption ends with a full stop
break_it.what_happens: it is not asked for unless it carries a verb

break_it.scenario: a clause continues at the top of the next page before copied list items
break_it.what_happens: the continuation is its own sentence and is found missing

post_merge.manual_verify: review re-reads of KRG 14G, 14I and Campbelltown Part 4 show 0 lost council sentences in the loss check
